evals.load.file_tag_dir: files entry %q: !file %q is a directory; use fixture: to copy a directory
evals.load.file_tag_irregular: files entry %q: !file %q is not a regular file
evals.load.file_tag_too_big: files entry %q: !file %q has %d bytes, more than the %d-byte limit; use fixture: for large files
evals.load.fixture_not_dir: fixture %q is a file, not a directory: point fixture: at the directory that holds it, or use files: with !file for a single file
evals.load.tag_misplaced: line %d: !file works only as the value of a files: entry, for example go.mod: !file testdata/go.mod
evals.load.tag_unknown: line %d: unknown tag %s (the only tag a suite accepts is !file, on a files: entry)
evals.record.parse: eval record %s is not valid JSON
